svg.title: ECHO evidence hierarchy for frontier AI governance
svg.desc: Five stacked levels move from executive statements at the base to independently enforceable and continuously verified controls at the top. Confidence increases as evidence becomes less dependent on the governed company.
svg.text: A safety claim becomes stronger as access, independence, and enforcement increase.
What a leader says should happen. Useful for declared intent; weakest evidence of implementation.
Published thresholds, processes, safety cases, reporting duties, or deployment rules.
Identity, least privilege, sandboxing, monitoring, action gates, logging, isolation, recovery.
Third parties inspect systems and internal evidence with editorial independence.
Outside authority can verify continuously and trigger binding intervention.
ECHO research instrument · Not a safety ranking of companies.
